claim: Saves multiple named 3–10-step routes, announces the current step, highlights its visible page target, and provides 48 px or larger Back and Next controls.
where: landing page, demo, extension popup, README
sandbox: fresh packaged MV3 profile; burst-record a ten-step route, add a second named route, start following, and operate the injected reader

claim: Uses accessible control names, never stores typed values or screenshots, and ignores password controls completely.
sandbox: fresh packaged MV3 profile; click an aria-labelledby button and labeled password input, then inspect extension storage

claim: Saved routes stay on this device and recording makes no external request.
sandbox: fresh packaged MV3 profile; start and record a real route through the popup and content script while intercepting requests

claim: The extension makes no background network request until a supporter token is restored; verification then contacts only api.sociobot.in.
sandbox: fresh packaged MV3 profile; observe startup and route recording traffic, restore a fixture token, and assert the only request is one GET to the Sociobot verification endpoint

claim: A route can be paused, resumed, annotated, exported, and deleted with confirmation.
sandbox: fresh packaged MV3 profile; exercise each operation and inspect saved state and downloads

claim: Exports the complete route as readable Markdown and JSON files.
sandbox: fresh /demo; download both formats and assert all five sample steps

claim: The free reader and sample demo require no account.
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter the demo and advance a route step without authentication fields

claim: Demo changes stay in memory, never touch durable or real extension data, and are discarded when starting for real.
sandbox: fresh /demo; edit sample data, inspect localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, and all requests, then use Start for real and re-enter the demo

claim: The site and sample route work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; prime /demo, switch the context offline, reload, and advance a sample step

claim: Public pages load no analytics, external fonts, or third-party scripts.
sandbox: fresh browser context; intercept all home, privacy, and terms requests and inspect script and stylesheet origins

claim: A $12 one-time supporter license restores in the extension, adds Blueprint, Graphite, and Sunrise covers there, and leaves the reader free.
where: landing supporter section, extension popup, README, terms
sandbox: fresh packaged MV3 profile with recorded Sociobot verification fixtures; restore valid and revoked tokens, apply each cover, and start a free route

claim: Browser settings pages cannot be read.
sandbox: inspect the packaged MV3 content-script match patterns and permissions

claim: The downloadable package is a Manifest V3 extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, and similar browsers.
where: landing install section, README install section, README development details
sandbox: inspect the freshly built packaged extension manifest

claim: After checkout, an installed extension restores the returned token; the token can also be copied into the extension.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load a returned license URL and assert the URL is scrubbed and the extension restore direction is visible
